alarming.oewn-00194616-a.label: negative

family.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

alarming.oewn-00194616-a.tone: The mildest force here — fear pinned to a danger you can recognise, which makes it a warning rather than the sheer horror of *horrifying*.

appalling.oewn-00194968-s.label: negative

family.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

appalling.oewn-00194968-s.tone: Consternation at full weight — it knocks the composure sideways, where *dismaying* only unsettles it.

dismaying.oewn-00194968-s.label: negative

family.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

dismaying.oewn-00194968-s.tone: The gentler consternation: spirits sink rather than reel, and the thing is not condemned outright as *appalling* condemns it.

atrocious.oewn-00195081-s.label: negative

family.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

atrocious.oewn-00195081-s.tone: Condemns as much as it describes — the horror is charged to the thing as a fault, where *horrifying* only reports the effect.

frightful.oewn-00195081-s.label: negative

family.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

frightful.oewn-00195081-s.tone: Fright rather than full horror — the same sense worn lightly enough to sound almost decorous beside *horrifying*.

horrifying.oewn-00195081-s.label: negative

family.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

horrifying.oewn-00195081-s.tone: Keeps the verb's live action, the thing doing the horrifying to you as you watch, where *horrible* merely names the quality.

horrible.oewn-00195081-s.label: negative

family.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

horrible.oewn-00195081-s.tone: The plain, all-purpose word for the quality — it states the horror without staging it.

ugly.oewn-00195081-s.label: negative

family.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

ugly.oewn-00195081-s.tone: Nothing to do with looks here: a blunt, unadorned word for what provokes horror, and the flatness is the whole of its force.

awful.oewn-00195400-s.label: negative

family.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

awful.oewn-00195400-s.tone: Broad and unspecific — it names the terror without picturing it, where *fearsome* gives the thing a shape.

dire.oewn-00195400-s.label: negative

family.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

dire.oewn-00195400-s.tone: Grave and flat, treating the terror as a settled fact of the situation with none of the flourish of *direful*.

direful.oewn-00195400-s.label: negative

family.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

direful.oewn-00195400-s.tone: The heightened form, reaching for a weight that *dire* carries without effort.

dread.oewn-00195400-s.label: negative

family.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

dread.oewn-00195400-s.tone: Elevated, almost ceremonial — the terror is stated as an attribute the thing simply has, not an effect it works on you.

dreaded.oewn-00195400-s.label: negative

family.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

dreaded.oewn-00195400-s.tone: The participle turns the fear around: the thing is defined by the dread already aimed at it, where *dreadful* says it causes dread.

dreadful.oewn-00195400-s.label: negative

family.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

dreadful.oewn-00195400-s.tone: Says plainly that the thing causes dread — the workaday partner to *dread*'s elevation.

fearful.oewn-00195400-s.label: negative

family.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

fearful.oewn-00195400-s.tone: Points outward at what causes the fear rather than inward at whoever feels it, the opposite reading to the one the word's shape invites.

fearsome.oewn-00195400-s.label: negative

family.axis: unease at a danger noticed → terror at full strength

fearsome.oewn-00195400-s.tone: Concedes stature to what frightens — the terror it names is formidable, not merely nasty as in *horrible*.

permanent.oewn-01758923-a.label: neutral

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

permanent.oewn-01758923-a.tone: Flat and factual — the bare statement that a condition holds, without the warmth *lasting* can pick up.

lasting.oewn-01758923-a.label: neutral

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

lasting.oewn-01758923-a.tone: Softer than *permanent* — duration sounds like something the thing has rather than a status fixed onto it.

abiding.oewn-01759375-s.label: positive

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

abiding.oewn-01759375-s.tone: Makes long duration sound like constancy, where *enduring* makes it sound like resistance.

enduring.oewn-01759375-s.label: positive

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

enduring.oewn-01759375-s.tone: Long duration framed as strength, as though the thing had to hold out to reach it.

imperishable.oewn-01759375-s.label: positive

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

imperishable.oewn-01759375-s.tone: The strongest of the long-lasting three: not holding out like *enduring* but beyond decay altogether, which treats what it names as worth keeping.

ageless.oewn-01759536-s.label: positive

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

ageless.oewn-01759536-s.tone: Presents going on indefinitely as something to be envied rather than merely measured, where *perpetual* only records the running on.

aeonian.oewn-01759536-s.label: neutral

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

aeonian.oewn-01759536-s.tone: Lofty and bookish — endlessness stated in the grandest available terms with no judgement attached to it.

eonian.oewn-01759536-s.label: neutral

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

eonian.oewn-01759536-s.tone: Carries the same elevated, uncommitted weight as *aeonian*, adding nothing and softening nothing.

eternal.oewn-01759536-s.label: neutral

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

eternal.oewn-01759536-s.tone: Solemn and absolute — it makes endlessness a property of the thing rather than a stretch of time, and still approves of nothing.

everlasting.oewn-01759536-s.label: positive

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

everlasting.oewn-01759536-s.tone: Warmer than *eternal* — the endlessness sounds like something held onto rather than a fact declared.

everlasting.oewn-01524174-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

everlasting.oewn-01524174-s.tone: Carries exasperation into the intensifier, insisting the quality will not let up, where *utter* simply fixes its extent.

perpetual.oewn-01759536-s.label: neutral

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

perpetual.oewn-01759536-s.tone: Endlessness as plain mechanism, running on without the grandeur *eternal* brings to the same span.

unending.oewn-01759536-s.label: neutral

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

unending.oewn-01759536-s.tone: Frames endlessness as the plain absence of a stop, without the grandeur *eternal* brings or the warmth of *everlasting*.

unceasing.oewn-01759536-s.label: negative

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

unceasing.oewn-01759536-s.tone: Presses on the missing pause, so what continues indefinitely reads as relentless rather than simply long.

standing.oewn-01760020-s.label: neutral

family.axis: lasts a long while → never ends

standing.oewn-01760020-s.tone: Positional rather than evaluative — it marks a thing as kept ready for whatever comes instead of raised for one occasion.

healthy.oewn-01173787-a.label: positive

family.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

healthy.oewn-01173787-a.tone: The flat baseline of the family, a verdict passed on body or mind alike with none of the visible glow *rosy* insists on.

flushed.oewn-01174367-s.label: positive

family.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

flushed.oewn-01174367-s.tone: Reads health off the skin's colour instead of declaring it, offering evidence where *healthy* offers a judgement.

rose-cheeked.oewn-01174367-s.label: positive

family.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

rose-cheeked.oewn-01174367-s.tone: Puts the same pink flush in one place, the cheeks, which turns *flushed*'s observation into a portrait.

rosy.oewn-01174367-s.label: positive

family.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

rosy.oewn-01174367-s.tone: The single unadorned stroke of the pink-flush words, letting the glow stand alone rather than pinning it to a face as *rosy-cheeked* does.

rosy.oewn-01668621-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain expectation of a good outcome → optimism so complete it no longer checks against fact

rosy.oewn-01668621-s.tone: The shorter, warmer form beside *rose-colored*, and the readier of the two to stand as simple praise for how a prospect looks.

rosy-cheeked.oewn-01174367-s.label: positive

family.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

rosy-cheeked.oewn-01174367-s.tone: Spells out where *rosy*'s glow sits, and the extra word makes it fonder and more picturesque.

bouncing.oewn-01174528-s.label: positive

family.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

bouncing.oewn-01174528-s.tone: Health with energy spilling out of it, so where *healthy* reports a condition this one moves.

firm.oewn-01174620-s.label: positive

family.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

firm.oewn-01174620-s.tone: Judges health by touch, tone and resilience in the tissue itself, not the colour *rosy* shows nor the vigour *bouncing* spends.

good.oewn-01174757-s.label: positive

family.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

good.oewn-01174757-s.tone: The unshowy top of the scale, excellent condition stated without a flourish where *hale* reaches for one.

sound.oewn-01174757-s.label: positive

family.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

sound.oewn-01174757-s.tone: Says the same excellent condition as *good* with the ring of a verdict rather than a compliment.

hale.oewn-01174940-s.label: positive

family.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

hale.oewn-01174940-s.tone: Formal and a little grand, and it covers vigour regained as readily as vigour never lost.

whole.oewn-01174940-s.label: positive

family.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

whole.oewn-01174940-s.tone: Frames that same vigorous health as entirety, leaning on the restored side where *hale* leans on the display.

hearty.oewn-01175150-s.label: positive

family.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

hearty.oewn-01175150-s.tone: Approves through appetite, abundance taken with relish, so it praises how someone eats rather than how they are.

full-blooded.oewn-01175290-s.label: positive

family.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

full-blooded.oewn-01175290-s.tone: Treats great health of body or mind as something carried in the constitution, possessed as much as shown.

lusty.oewn-01175290-s.label: positive

family.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

lusty.oewn-01175290-s.tone: Pitches the same great bodily or mental health as raw force, louder and more physical than *full-blooded*.

red-blooded.oewn-01175290-s.label: positive

family.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

red-blooded.oewn-01175290-s.tone: Sounds like a boast, great health of body or mind worn as vitality rather than merely reported as *healthy* would.

anicteric.oewn-01175499-s.label: neutral

family.axis: health as a plain condition → health as visible, spilling-over vigour

anicteric.oewn-01175499-s.tone: Clinical and purely negative in shape, saying only that jaundice is absent and carrying none of the approval the rest of the family trades in.

provocative.oewn-01902545-a.label: neutral

family.axis: stirring discussion → inciting revolt

provocative.oewn-01902545-a.tone: The neutral base of the family - it names the power to excite, stimulate or set off controversy without settling whether that is welcome, where *provoking* fixes the reaction as anger.

agitative.oewn-01902992-s.label: negative

family.axis: stirring discussion → inciting revolt

agitative.oewn-01902992-s.tone: Flat and clinical for what it describes, labelling a thing as anger-producing by disposition rather than catching the anger or resentment in the act.

agitating.oewn-01902992-s.label: negative

family.axis: stirring discussion → inciting revolt

agitating.oewn-01902992-s.tone: The participle keeps the effect live - anger and resentment being stirred now, where *agitative* states a settled property.

provoking.oewn-01902992-s.label: negative

family.axis: stirring discussion → inciting revolt

provoking.oewn-01902992-s.tone: Blunt and personal beside the clinical *agitative* - the anger or resentment it names is felt as an affront by someone in particular.

challenging.oewn-01903173-s.label: neutral

family.axis: stirring discussion → inciting revolt

challenging.oewn-01903173-s.tone: The disturbance is set before you as something to be met, so the discomfort arrives with a demand attached rather than a verdict.

intriguing.oewn-01903173-s.label: positive

family.axis: stirring discussion → inciting revolt

intriguing.oewn-01903173-s.tone: Here the disturbance pulls instead of repelling - what unsettles is also what fascinates, where *challenging* wants an answer out of you.

charged.oewn-01903291-s.label: negative

family.axis: stirring discussion → inciting revolt

charged.oewn-01903291-s.tone: Names a load waiting to go off, the violent feeling or the controversy stored in the thing and not yet released, where *inflammatory* names something already doing the work.

incendiary.oewn-01903445-s.label: negative

family.axis: stirring discussion → inciting revolt

incendiary.oewn-01903445-s.tone: Carries the image of a fire set on purpose, so stirring people to act or to rise is treated as damage waiting to happen.

incitive.oewn-01903445-s.label: negative

family.axis: stirring discussion → inciting revolt

incitive.oewn-01903445-s.tone: A bare, near-technical label for the same power to move people to action or revolt, with none of the heat *incendiary* puts under it.

inflammatory.oewn-01903445-s.label: negative

family.axis: stirring discussion → inciting revolt

inflammatory.oewn-01903445-s.tone: The heat is the whole point - it treats the thing as what sets the action or the rebellion alight, not merely the occasion for it.

instigative.oewn-01903445-s.label: negative

family.axis: stirring discussion → inciting revolt

instigative.oewn-01903445-s.tone: Points past the blaze to the hand behind it, naming what starts the action or the rising rather than how fiercely it burns.

rabble-rousing.oewn-01903445-s.label: negative

family.axis: stirring discussion → inciting revolt

rabble-rousing.oewn-01903445-s.tone: Contempt running both ways - it belittles those stirred to act as a mob and denies the stirring any cause worth having.

seditious.oewn-01903445-s.label: negative

family.axis: stirring discussion → inciting revolt

seditious.oewn-01903445-s.tone: The gravest word here - it treats rousing people to action or revolt as an offence against authority, where *incendiary* only warns of the fire.

rousing.oewn-01903674-s.label: positive

family.axis: stirring discussion → inciting revolt

rousing.oewn-01903674-s.tone: The one stirring in the family that is welcome, though the spurring and goading in it keep an edge of being driven to act rather than persuaded.

hopeless.oewn-01231893-a.label: negative

family.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing

hopeless.oewn-01231893-a.tone: The family's plain verdict, hope absent because no comfort or success looks possible — a reading of the odds where *despairing* is a reading of the feeling.

abject.oewn-01232308-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing

abject.oewn-01232308-s.tone: The most degrading member: utter resignation or hopelessness worn openly, so that the giving-up is itself what gets judged.

unhopeful.oewn-01232308-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing

unhopeful.oewn-01232308-s.tone: A bare negation covering the same utter resignation or hopelessness as *abject*, but with the contempt drained out and understatement left to carry it.

black.oewn-01232434-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing

black.oewn-01232434-s.tone: Paints the little-or-no hope rather than measuring it, and paints it unrelieved, which is what puts it past *dim*.

bleak.oewn-01232434-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing

bleak.oewn-01232434-s.tone: The same shortage of hope felt as bareness and exposure rather than as the darkness of *black*.

dim.oewn-01232434-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing

dim.oewn-01232434-s.tone: The mildest of the three, since it sits on the “little” rather than the “no” — hope faint but not yet out.

despairing.oewn-01232699-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing

despairing.oewn-01232699-s.tone: Points at the despair itself, whether a thing arises from that loss of hope or merely bears its mark, where *hopeless* points at the prospects.

desperate.oewn-01232699-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing

desperate.oewn-01232699-s.tone: The straining side of the same despair — something arising from lost hope rather than merely showing it, so it pushes where *despairing* only mourns.

despondent.oewn-01233026-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing

despondent.oewn-01233026-s.tone: A sunk, settled state with hope gone or all but gone, heavier than *dim* and far quieter than *desperate*.

heartsick.oewn-01233026-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing

heartsick.oewn-01233026-s.tone: Puts that same absent-or-nearly-absent hope in the body, a sickness felt rather than the low weight of *despondent*.

forlorn.oewn-01233260-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing

forlorn.oewn-01233260-s.tone: Hopelessness that is marked or shown in a way inviting pity, not the reproach *abject* invites.

futureless.oewn-01233394-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing

futureless.oewn-01233394-s.tone: Turns the loss forward — neither prospect nor hope of a future — a flat structural verdict beside the mood of *forlorn*.

helpless.oewn-01233489-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing

helpless.oewn-01233489-s.tone: Two failures at once, no power to function and no help at hand, which makes it sound like a plea rather than the verdict *hopeless* delivers.

lost.oewn-01233489-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing

lost.oewn-01233489-s.tone: Carries the same inability and the same want of help as *helpless*, but as a settled condition rather than a moment of one, so it sounds past rescue.

insoluble.oewn-01233601-s.label: neutral

family.axis: faint hope still left → hope wholly gone and the collapse showing

insoluble.oewn-01233601-s.tone: The member aimed at what admits no solution rather than at anyone, a flat statement that none is to be hoped for, carrying no reproach of its own.

frivolous.oewn-02127738-a.label: negative

family.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

frivolous.oewn-02127738-a.tone: The family's plain term and its widest, attaching to content, attitude or behaviour alike without the picture of a hollow head that the compounds beside it supply.

airheaded.oewn-02128108-s.label: negative

family.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

airheaded.oewn-02128108-s.tone: Blunt mockery that explains the unseriousness by putting air where the thinking should be, where *frivolous* just reports the lack.

dizzy.oewn-02128108-s.label: negative

family.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

dizzy.oewn-02128108-s.tone: Whirl rather than vacancy, the lightest hit in the group and closer to teasing than to the contempt in *empty-headed*.

empty-headed.oewn-02128108-s.label: negative

family.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

empty-headed.oewn-02128108-s.tone: The flattest insult in the set: it does not merely find the person unserious but asserts there is nothing inside to be serious with.

featherbrained.oewn-02128108-s.label: negative

family.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

featherbrained.oewn-02128108-s.tone: Mockery by weighing the brain, making the frivolity ridiculous rather than merely noting it as *silly* does.

giddy.oewn-02128108-s.label: negative

family.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

giddy.oewn-02128108-s.tone: Lightness with a lift to it, the unseriousness felt as high spirits, so it stings far less than *empty-headed*.

light-headed.oewn-02128108-s.label: negative

family.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

light-headed.oewn-02128108-s.tone: The same charge as *giddy* stated as a property of the head rather than a mood, and a light head is still not the vacant one *empty-headed* alleges.

lightheaded.oewn-02128108-s.label: negative

family.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

lightheaded.oewn-02128108-s.tone: The unhyphenated twin of *light-headed*, identical in force: a light head, not an empty one.

silly.oewn-02128108-s.label: negative

family.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

silly.oewn-02128108-s.tone: The plainest and most forgiving word for the fault, naming the frivolity without a metaphor for the head and leaving room for fondness that *airheaded* forecloses.

flighty.oewn-02128403-s.label: negative

family.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

flighty.oewn-02128403-s.tone: Whim read as unreliability, so it warns about conduct where *head-in-the-clouds* only pictures a drift.

flyaway.oewn-02128403-s.label: negative

family.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

flyaway.oewn-02128403-s.tone: The lightest reading of a life run by whim and fancy: loose and ungoverned rather than a fault to be answered for.

head-in-the-clouds.oewn-02128403-s.label: negative

family.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

head-in-the-clouds.oewn-02128403-s.tone: Indulgent almost to fondness, the whim and fancy carrying the person off rather than damning them, unlike *scatterbrained*'s charge of disorder.

scatterbrained.oewn-02128403-s.label: negative

family.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

scatterbrained.oewn-02128403-s.tone: Whim as scatter: the fault is that attention will not hold together, which *flighty* leaves as mere changeability.

flippant.oewn-02128570-s.label: negative

family.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

flippant.oewn-02128570-s.tone: The verdict is built in, the levity being out of place, so the word rebukes a manner rather than diagnosing a mind as *empty-headed* does.

light-minded.oewn-02128570-s.label: negative

family.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

light-minded.oewn-02128570-s.tone: The measured version of *flippant*'s fault, locating the misplaced levity in a cast of mind instead of throwing it back at the offender.

idle.oewn-02128704-s.label: negative

family.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

idle.oewn-02128704-s.tone: It runs to two things at once, the silly and the trivial, so the dismissal is as much about weightlessness as about foolishness.

decisive.oewn-00687757-a.label: neutral

family.axis: holding the power to settle an outcome → settling it with a weight that shuts everything else down

decisive.oewn-00687757-a.tone: The family's plain baseline, covering both the thing that actually determines an outcome and the thing merely holding the power to, and taking no view on how the outcome falls.

deciding.oewn-00688059-s.label: neutral

family.axis: holding the power to settle an outcome → settling it with a weight that shuts everything else down

deciding.oewn-00688059-s.tone: The plainest member — the power or quality of deciding stated with no formality at all, where *determinative* says as much in a starched collar.

determinant.oewn-00688059-s.label: neutral

family.axis: holding the power to settle an outcome → settling it with a weight that shuts everything else down

determinant.oewn-00688059-s.tone: Formal and analytic, naming the deciding power as a property a factor holds rather than anything it is seen to do.

determinative.oewn-00688059-s.label: neutral

family.axis: holding the power to settle an outcome → settling it with a weight that shuts everything else down

determinative.oewn-00688059-s.tone: Formal, and tilted toward deciding as a standing quality, where *determining* is that same power caught in the act.

determining.oewn-00688059-s.label: neutral

family.axis: holding the power to settle an outcome → settling it with a weight that shuts everything else down

determining.oewn-00688059-s.tone: The deciding power shown in use rather than merely held, which gives it a motion *determinant* lacks.

fateful.oewn-00688390-s.label: negative

family.axis: holding the power to settle an outcome → settling it with a weight that shuts everything else down

fateful.oewn-00688390-s.tone: Adds gravity to plain importance — consequences big enough to feel handed down, with a shadow across them that *deciding* has no room for.

fatal.oewn-00688390-s.label: negative

family.axis: holding the power to settle an outcome → settling it with a weight that shuts everything else down

fatal.oewn-00688390-s.tone: The darkest way this family has of saying momentous — it makes decisive importance sound like doom arriving, where *fateful* only makes it weighty.

peremptory.oewn-00688642-s.label: negative

family.axis: holding the power to settle an outcome → settling it with a weight that shuts everything else down

peremptory.oewn-00688642-s.tone: Force with no courtesy in it: rather than settle an outcome it slams the door on debate and action alike, leaving nothing to answer.

bodied.oewn-00630690-a.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possession of a body → a body specified closely enough to flatter or fault

bodied.oewn-00630690-a.tone: The unmarked base of the set - it says only that a body is there, or that one of a stated kind is, and waits for a word in front of it to say which.

incarnate.oewn-00631042-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possession of a body → a body specified closely enough to flatter or fault

incarnate.oewn-00631042-s.tone: The one member that treats embodiment as something conferred rather than measured, and it carries a gravity the shape words never reach for.

lithe-bodied.oewn-00631195-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possession of a body → a body specified closely enough to flatter or fault

lithe-bodied.oewn-00631195-s.tone: Praises suppleness rather than outline - where *slim-bodied* reports a shape, this admires the ease of one.

long-bodied.oewn-00631273-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possession of a body → a body specified closely enough to flatter or fault

long-bodied.oewn-00631273-s.tone: Pure measurement along a single axis, and a comparative one at that - it reports length against other bodies without admiring or faulting it.

narrow-bodied.oewn-00631360-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possession of a body → a body specified closely enough to flatter or fault

narrow-bodied.oewn-00631360-s.tone: Measures across where *long-bodied* measures along, and is just as uncommitted about whether narrowness is a virtue.

oval-bodied.oewn-00631451-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possession of a body → a body specified closely enough to flatter or fault

oval-bodied.oewn-00631451-s.tone: Names a whole outline instead of one dimension - the most purely geometric word here and the least interested in judging what it draws.

short-bodied.oewn-00631528-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possession of a body → a body specified closely enough to flatter or fault

short-bodied.oewn-00631528-s.tone: The mirror of *long-bodied* and just as flat - shortness is given as a proportion, not held against the thing that has it.

silver-bodied.oewn-00631617-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possession of a body → a body specified closely enough to flatter or fault

silver-bodied.oewn-00631617-s.tone: Names the colour flatly, letting the metal's name stand in for the shade.

silvery-bodied.oewn-00631617-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possession of a body → a body specified closely enough to flatter or fault

silvery-bodied.oewn-00631617-s.tone: The suffix softens the same colour into resemblance - a sheen suggested where *silver-bodied* names the shade outright.

slim-bodied.oewn-00631722-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possession of a body → a body specified closely enough to flatter or fault

slim-bodied.oewn-00631722-s.tone: Slimness stated with quiet approval - the plainest of the favourable three, complimentary without reaching for grace.

thin-bodied.oewn-00631722-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possession of a body → a body specified closely enough to flatter or fault

thin-bodied.oewn-00631722-s.tone: The same slimness with the compliment drained out - where *slim-bodied* approves, this can land as merely scant.

slender-bodied.oewn-00631722-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possession of a body → a body specified closely enough to flatter or fault

slender-bodied.oewn-00631722-s.tone: The most admiring way to report slimness, lending it an elegance *thin-bodied* withholds.

smooth-bodied.oewn-00631829-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possession of a body → a body specified closely enough to flatter or fault

smooth-bodied.oewn-00631829-s.tone: Reports surface rather than dimension, and the agreeableness in it belongs to the texture rather than to any verdict on the body.

thick-bodied.oewn-00631909-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare possession of a body → a body specified closely enough to flatter or fault

thick-bodied.oewn-00631909-s.tone: The one dimension word here that can land as a verdict instead of a measurement, reading as bulk where *slim-bodied* reads as trim.

unmitigated.oewn-01523886-a.label: negative

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

unmitigated.oewn-01523886-a.tone: Names the absence of relief - the intensity or severity has had nothing taken off it - where *utter* only says the quality is entire.

arrant.oewn-01524174-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

arrant.oewn-01524174-s.tone: Openly contemptuous rather than merely absolute - it disparages the thing it magnifies, where *complete* only measures it.

complete.oewn-01524174-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

complete.oewn-01524174-s.tone: The plainest amplifier of the set - it adds fullness and takes whatever scorn is already in the noun.

consummate.oewn-01524174-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

consummate.oewn-01524174-s.tone: Totalizes with an air of accomplishment, as though the quality had been brought to a finish, and that mismatch gives it a wryness *utter* has none of.

double-dyed.oewn-01524174-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

double-dyed.oewn-01524174-s.tone: Condemning - it presents the quality as set fast and past removing, going further than *thorough*, which only says it runs all the way through.

gross.oewn-01524174-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

gross.oewn-01524174-s.tone: Blunt and coarse - it enlarges the quality and looks down on it in a single move.

perfect.oewn-01524174-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

perfect.oewn-01524174-s.tone: Turns a word of flawlessness into a measure of extent, and gains its edge over *complete* through that mismatch.

pure.oewn-01524174-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

pure.oewn-01524174-s.tone: Intensifies by denying any admixture - the quality stands undiluted, which is a different claim from *utter*'s nothing-left-over.

sodding.oewn-01524174-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

sodding.oewn-01524174-s.tone: British and profane - the most abusive of these, spending contempt before it has said anything about degree at all.

stark.oewn-01524174-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

stark.oewn-01524174-s.tone: Bleak in its emphasis, leaving the quality bare and unrelieved rather than merely entire as *complete* does.

staring.oewn-01524174-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

staring.oewn-01524174-s.tone: Makes the quality conspicuous as well as total - impossible to overlook, where *utter* says nothing about how visible it is.

thorough.oewn-01524174-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

thorough.oewn-01524174-s.tone: Amplifies by saying the quality runs the whole way through, a claim about extent with no scorn of its own.

thoroughgoing.oewn-01524174-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

thoroughgoing.oewn-01524174-s.tone: Heavier on the tongue than *thorough*, and the extra weight is insistence on completeness rather than added disparagement.

utter.oewn-01524174-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

utter.oewn-01524174-s.tone: Flat and absolute - it allows no remainder, and unlike *arrant* it supplies no sneer of its own.

unadulterated.oewn-01524174-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

unadulterated.oewn-01524174-s.tone: The most deliberate of these amplifiers, spelling out that nothing has been mixed in to weaken the quality where *pure* asserts it in a breath.

improper.oewn-01886613-a.label: negative

family.axis: a mismatch with established procedure → an offense against accepted standards

improper.oewn-01886613-a.tone: The flattest disapproval here - it marks a thing as not fitting without naming the standard it fails, where *unseemly* and *indecent* both point at one.

indecent.oewn-01887000-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mismatch with established procedure → an offense against accepted standards

indecent.oewn-01887000-s.tone: Blunt and severe where *indecorous* is measured - the same breach of what polite society accepts, named with nothing held back.

indecorous.oewn-01887000-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mismatch with established procedure → an offense against accepted standards

indecorous.oewn-01887000-s.tone: Formal and cool, faulting the breach as a lapse of decorum rather than an outrage, which is exactly where it parts from *indecent*.

unbecoming.oewn-01887000-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mismatch with established procedure → an offense against accepted standards

unbecoming.oewn-01887000-s.tone: Measures the breach against whoever commits it - the conduct falls below what suits them, where *indecorous* faults the conduct alone.

uncomely.oewn-01887000-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mismatch with established procedure → an offense against accepted standards

uncomely.oewn-01887000-s.tone: Faint and formal - it registers the breach of accepted standards as unattractive rather than shocking, staying well back from *indecent*.

unseemly.oewn-01887000-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mismatch with established procedure → an offense against accepted standards

unseemly.oewn-01887000-s.tone: Firm and plain-spoken: the conduct does not fit at all, which is more pointed than *indecorous* and less scandalized than *indecent*.

untoward.oewn-01887000-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mismatch with established procedure → an offense against accepted standards

untoward.oewn-01887000-s.tone: The most restrained of this set, glancing at the breach rather than rebuking it as *unseemly* does.

out-of-the-way.oewn-01887447-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mismatch with established procedure → an offense against accepted standards

out-of-the-way.oewn-01887447-s.tone: Mild in shape but broad in reach - it runs from merely improper right through to offensive, and the understatement is what makes the far end land.

out_of_the_way.oewn-01887447-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mismatch with established procedure → an offense against accepted standards

out_of_the_way.oewn-01887447-s.tone: The spaced spelling carries the same span, improper at its softest and offensive at its hardest, with no more heat in it than *out-of-the-way*.

wrong.oewn-01887577-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a mismatch with established procedure → an offense against accepted standards

wrong.oewn-01887577-s.tone: Purely a measure against established usage or procedure - it records a mismatch rather than passing judgement, which is what separates it from *improper*.

incorrect.oewn-01887577-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a mismatch with established procedure → an offense against accepted standards

incorrect.oewn-01887577-s.tone: Cooler and more technical than *wrong* - the same failure to accord with established procedure, stated as a matter of record.

optimistic.oewn-01668036-a.label: positive

family.axis: plain expectation of a good outcome → optimism so complete it no longer checks against fact

optimistic.oewn-01668036-a.tone: The unmarked term for expecting the best, and the only one here that neither congratulates the expectation nor doubts it.

bullish.oewn-01668381-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plain expectation of a good outcome → optimism so complete it no longer checks against fact

bullish.oewn-01668381-s.tone: Positional rather than evaluative: it names an expectation that prices will rise, taking no view of the person holding it the way *optimistic* does.

cheerful.oewn-01668480-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain expectation of a good outcome → optimism so complete it no longer checks against fact

cheerful.oewn-01668480-s.tone: Leads with the pleasantness and leaves the unrealism in the background, where *pollyannaish* brings it to the front.

pollyannaish.oewn-01668480-s.label: negative

family.axis: plain expectation of a good outcome → optimism so complete it no longer checks against fact

pollyannaish.oewn-01668480-s.tone: Hangs its whole weight on the unrealistic half of the same pleasant optimism, so the good cheer itself becomes the failing.

upbeat.oewn-01668480-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain expectation of a good outcome → optimism so complete it no longer checks against fact

upbeat.oewn-01668480-s.tone: Buoyant and forward-leaning where *cheerful* is merely pleasant, and it carries the least doubt of the three.

rose-colored.oewn-01668621-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain expectation of a good outcome → optimism so complete it no longer checks against fact

rose-colored.oewn-01668621-s.tone: Puts the optimism into what is being shown rather than into the one holding it, so it colours a view instead of judging a temperament.

starry-eyed.oewn-01668775-s.label: negative

family.axis: plain expectation of a good outcome → optimism so complete it no longer checks against fact

starry-eyed.oewn-01668775-s.tone: Marks the optimism as a fault either way — whether it has outrun the facts or never met them — and the dreaminess is the point.

sanguine.oewn-01668920-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain expectation of a good outcome → optimism so complete it no longer checks against fact

sanguine.oewn-01668920-s.tone: Adds steadiness to the cheer: confidence held, not merely expectation entertained, which is what lifts it past *optimistic*.

sanguineous.oewn-01668920-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain expectation of a good outcome → optimism so complete it no longer checks against fact

sanguineous.oewn-01668920-s.tone: The heavier, more formal twin of *sanguine* for the same confident cheer, the weight falling on the word rather than the mood.

dejected.oewn-00706554-a.label: negative

family.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

dejected.oewn-00706554-a.tone: The plain, unmarked word for the state - it reports low spirits without the finality of *amort* or the weather of *gloomy*.

amort.oewn-00706811-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

amort.oewn-00706811-s.tone: Absolute rather than graded - 'utterly' leaves no degrees to argue about, putting it at the far end from a merely *low* mood.

chapfallen.oewn-00706899-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

chapfallen.oewn-00706899-s.tone: Identical in sense to *chopfallen*, and like it stresses being brought low - a spirit put down from a height rather than one that was always down.

chopfallen.oewn-00706899-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

chopfallen.oewn-00706899-s.tone: The blunter-sounding twin of *chapfallen*: the force is in the fall, not in the level reached.

crestfallen.oewn-00706899-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

crestfallen.oewn-00706899-s.tone: Implies the spirit stood higher before it was lowered, which *gloomy* and *low* do not.

deflated.oewn-00706899-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

deflated.oewn-00706899-s.tone: Flatness rather than darkness - the spirit reads as having gone out of something, the mildest and most deadpan of the brought-low set.

gloomy.oewn-00707060-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

gloomy.oewn-00707060-s.tone: Suffuses rather than strikes - the despondency reads as a settled climate around the person, where *deflated* reads as one blow.

grim.oewn-00707060-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

grim.oewn-00707060-s.tone: Hard-edged where *gloomy* is merely overcast - melancholy that has set and will not be coaxed out of.

blue.oewn-00707060-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

blue.oewn-00707060-s.tone: The softest word here - it makes despondency sound like a passing shade, understating what the sense actually covers.

depressed.oewn-00707060-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

depressed.oewn-00707060-s.tone: States the weight flatly and without consolation, none of the softening that *blue* or *down* carry.

dispirited.oewn-00707060-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

dispirited.oewn-00707060-s.tone: Names the loss rather than the mood - the spirit has been drained out, which registers as depletion beside *gloomy*'s heaviness.

down.oewn-00707060-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

down.oewn-00707060-s.tone: Informal and brief; it says the level and stops, understating beside *depressed*.

downcast.oewn-00707060-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

downcast.oewn-00707060-s.tone: More picture than *down* - the whole bearing is lowered, not only the mood.

downhearted.oewn-00707060-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

downhearted.oewn-00707060-s.tone: Gentle and sympathetic, seating the despondency in the heart and inviting comfort where *grim* forecloses it.

down_in_the_mouth.oewn-00707060-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

down_in_the_mouth.oewn-00707060-s.tone: Informal and faintly wry - it points at a visible droop instead of naming the feeling, making the state sound smaller than it is.

low.oewn-00707060-s.label: negative

family.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

low.oewn-00707060-s.tone: The barest term available - it gives the level and nothing else, so *downhearted*'s warmth and *grim*'s hardness both fall away.

unconventional.oewn-00610798-a.label: neutral

family.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

unconventional.oewn-00610798-a.tone: The flat, judgement-free naming of the departure itself, which *bizarre* and *outlandish* charge up into a verdict.

alternative.oewn-00611045-s.label: neutral

family.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

alternative.oewn-00611045-s.tone: Treats the unconventionality as something chosen, and a choice is describable without being deplored.

bizarre.oewn-00611168-s.label: negative

family.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

bizarre.oewn-00611168-s.tone: Strong and faintly appalled — the oddity is loud enough to unsettle, not merely to be noticed.

eccentric.oewn-00611168-s.label: negative

family.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

eccentric.oewn-00611168-s.tone: The most tolerant reading of the same conspicuous oddity, allowing it to be indulged where *freakish* will not.

freakish.oewn-00611168-s.label: negative

family.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

freakish.oewn-00611168-s.tone: Pushes the strangeness toward the unnatural, so the deviation sounds like a defect of kind rather than a quirk.

freaky.oewn-00611168-s.label: negative

family.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

freaky.oewn-00611168-s.tone: The informal, offhand counterpart to *freakish*, registering the strangeness as a jolt rather than a fault.

flaky.oewn-00611168-s.label: negative

family.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

flaky.oewn-00611168-s.tone: Informal and dismissive — the oddity is treated as too insubstantial to be taken seriously.

flakey.oewn-00611168-s.label: negative

family.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

flakey.oewn-00611168-s.tone: The variant spelling of *flaky*, carrying the identical shrug at strangeness that will not be weighed.

gonzo.oewn-00611168-s.label: neutral

family.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

gonzo.oewn-00611168-s.tone: Informal and almost relishing — the same conspicuous excess sounds enjoyed here, where *freakish* deplores it.

off-the-wall.oewn-00611168-s.label: negative

family.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

off-the-wall.oewn-00611168-s.tone: Informal and blunt, putting the oddity outside any expected range without making it a flaw of character.

outlandish.oewn-00611168-s.label: negative

family.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

outlandish.oewn-00611168-s.tone: The strangeness is excessive to the edge of absurdity, and the word scorns it where *eccentric* would indulge it.

outre.oewn-00611168-s.label: negative

family.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

outre.oewn-00611168-s.tone: Formal and cool, naming the same conspicuous strangeness with a raised eyebrow instead of *outlandish*'s scorn.

devil-may-care.oewn-00611718-s.label: neutral

family.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

devil-may-care.oewn-00611718-s.tone: Puts its weight on the carefreeness itself, which is what the word names whether the result reads as dash or as disrepute.

raffish.oewn-00611718-s.label: neutral

family.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

raffish.oewn-00611718-s.tone: Tilts toward the disreputable half of the sense, though the carefreeness keeps it amused rather than condemning.

rakish.oewn-00611718-s.label: positive

family.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

rakish.oewn-00611718-s.tone: Hears dash in the same carefree disrepute that *raffish* hears a shabbiness in.

far-out.oewn-00611941-s.label: positive

family.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

far-out.oewn-00611941-s.tone: Informal, and the striking quality lands as a thrill rather than a fault — the approving end of a family whose middle condemns.

worthy.oewn-02595419-a.label: positive

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

worthy.oewn-02595419-a.tone: The plain baseline of the family, covering both simply having value and being honorable, without fixing what praise is owed.

applaudable.oewn-02595965-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

applaudable.oewn-02595965-s.tone: The most demonstrative way to claim high praise, casting approval as something shown rather than merely stated, where *commendable* keeps it measured.

commendable.oewn-02595965-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

commendable.oewn-02595965-s.tone: Measured and official, granting high praise as though it were being formally entered rather than felt.

laudable.oewn-02595965-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

laudable.oewn-02595965-s.tone: The most formal of the high-praise set, elevated enough to sound ceremonious beside plainer *praiseworthy*.

praiseworthy.oewn-02595965-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

praiseworthy.oewn-02595965-s.tone: Names high praise directly and without ornament, saying what *laudable* says with none of its formality.

creditable.oewn-02596339-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

creditable.oewn-02596339-s.tone: Praise with a ceiling built in - it grants real merit while conceding the commendation is a limited one, stopping well short of *commendable*.

cum_laude.oewn-02596509-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

cum_laude.oewn-02596509-s.tone: A fixed formal honors formula, conferring academic distinction by rank instead of describing what earned it.

deserving.oewn-02596626-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

deserving.oewn-02596626-s.tone: Neutral on its face: it fixes only that some treatment is fitting, never that the treatment is a good one, which is exactly what lets it turn ironic.

worth.oewn-02596626-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

worth.oewn-02596626-s.tone: The barer form of the same judgement, stating that a treatment is merited without the weight *deserving* carries, and equally able to land ironically.

exemplary.oewn-02596887-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

exemplary.oewn-02596887-s.tone: The strongest claim here - not merely praised but held up as the standard others should copy.

model.oewn-02596887-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

model.oewn-02596887-s.tone: Fastens to the thing as a label rather than a verdict, naming it the pattern to be imitated where *exemplary* judges it.

magna_cum_laude.oewn-02597049-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

magna_cum_laude.oewn-02597049-s.tone: The graded step above *cum laude*, raising the honor a rank while keeping the same formal formula.

meritorious.oewn-02597188-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

meritorious.oewn-02597188-s.tone: Adds the idea of something owed - the praise is earned, and a reward is due along with it.

meritable.oewn-02597188-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

meritable.oewn-02597188-s.tone: The plainer formation of the same claim, carrying the earned reward without the ceremonious ring of *meritorious*.

quotable.oewn-02597398-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

quotable.oewn-02597398-s.tone: The mildest and most particular worth in the family, judging fitness for quotation as much as merit in it.

sacred.oewn-02597576-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

sacred.oewn-02597576-s.tone: Asks for reverence rather than applause - what it marks is to be respected or given over to, not simply admired as *worthy* things are.

original.oewn-01691099-a.label: positive

family.axis: not copied from a model → unprecedented enough to found what follows

original.oewn-01691099-a.tone: Does double duty - mild approval for something fresh and unusual, and a flat statement that a thing stands as first made or thought of.

avant-garde.oewn-01691548-s.label: positive

family.axis: not copied from a model → unprecedented enough to found what follows

avant-garde.oewn-01691548-s.tone: Approval for newness pushed to its edge, where the break with what came before is the whole of the claim - a bigger assertion than *fresh* makes.

daring.oewn-01691548-s.label: positive

family.axis: not copied from a model → unprecedented enough to found what follows

daring.oewn-01691548-s.tone: Praises the same radical newness as *avant-garde* but hears nerve in it, as though the thing is new because someone risked making it so.

freehand.oewn-01691672-s.label: neutral

family.axis: not copied from a model → unprecedented enough to found what follows

freehand.oewn-01691672-s.tone: Purely a statement of method - the hand working without mechanical aid or device - and it carries none of the approval the words beside it do.

freehanded.oewn-01691672-s.label: neutral

family.axis: not copied from a model → unprecedented enough to found what follows

freehanded.oewn-01691672-s.tone: Says exactly what *freehand* says and no more, still describing how a thing was done rather than passing any judgement on it.

fresh.oewn-01691809-s.label: positive

family.axis: not copied from a model → unprecedented enough to found what follows

fresh.oewn-01691809-s.tone: The warmest of the three that share this sense: not merely without precedent but welcome for it, where *new* only records the absence.

new.oewn-01691809-s.label: positive

family.axis: not copied from a model → unprecedented enough to found what follows

new.oewn-01691809-s.tone: The plainest way to make the claim - a thing is original and unlike anything seen before - with almost no approval loaded onto it.

novel.oewn-01691809-s.label: positive

family.axis: not copied from a model → unprecedented enough to found what follows

novel.oewn-01691809-s.tone: Cooler and more formal than *fresh*, treating the unlikeness to anything before as a fact worth remarking rather than a pleasure.

germinal.oewn-01692005-s.label: positive

family.axis: not copied from a model → unprecedented enough to found what follows

germinal.oewn-01692005-s.tone: Praise pointed forward - the thing is valued for the later development it holds in seed, not for what it already amounts to.

originative.oewn-01692005-s.label: positive

family.axis: not copied from a model → unprecedented enough to found what follows

originative.oewn-01692005-s.tone: The flattest of the three: it credits the power to start something without *germinal*'s picture of a seed and its growth.

seminal.oewn-01692005-s.label: positive

family.axis: not copied from a model → unprecedented enough to found what follows

seminal.oewn-01692005-s.tone: The heaviest praise here, treating the thing as the source everything afterwards grows out of - a standing *germinal* only promises.

innovative.oewn-01692228-s.label: positive

family.axis: not copied from a model → unprecedented enough to found what follows

innovative.oewn-01692228-s.tone: Approval that lands on the making: not simply that a thing is unprecedented but that someone brought something unprecedented about.

innovational.oewn-01692228-s.label: positive

family.axis: not copied from a model → unprecedented enough to found what follows

innovational.oewn-01692228-s.tone: The dry variant of *innovative*, sounding more like a classification of the thing than any compliment paid to it.

groundbreaking.oewn-01692228-s.label: positive

family.axis: not copied from a model → unprecedented enough to found what follows

groundbreaking.oewn-01692228-s.tone: The most emphatic way to say it - first through unbroken ground - where *innovative* states the same feat without the flourish.

underivative.oewn-01692607-s.label: positive

family.axis: not copied from a model → unprecedented enough to found what follows

underivative.oewn-01692607-s.tone: Praise made by subtraction: it clears a thing of owing itself to a source and of copying a model, without claiming freshness the way *original* does.

disorganized.oewn-01673111-a.label: negative

family.axis: merely unmethodical → snarled into total wreckage

disorganized.oewn-01673111-a.tone: The family's plain statement of the fault - order, methodical arrangement and working function all simply absent, with none of the wreckage *chaotic* pictures.

disorganised.oewn-01673111-a.label: negative

family.axis: merely unmethodical → snarled into total wreckage

disorganised.oewn-01673111-a.tone: Carries exactly the force of *disorganized*; the spelling is the whole of the difference.

broken.oewn-01673499-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely unmethodical → snarled into total wreckage

broken.oewn-01673499-s.tone: Of a thing thrown into disarray rather than snapped in two - the confusion reads as damage done to it, not merely order gone missing.

confused.oewn-01673499-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely unmethodical → snarled into total wreckage

confused.oewn-01673499-s.tone: Puts the muddle in the thing itself rather than in anyone's head - it is the arrangement that is tangled, not a mind.

disordered.oewn-01673499-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely unmethodical → snarled into total wreckage

disordered.oewn-01673499-s.tone: The flattest of these - it records that order has given way to disarray and stops there, where *broken* wants you to feel the blow.

upset.oewn-01673499-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely unmethodical → snarled into total wreckage

upset.oewn-01673499-s.tone: Pictures the disarray as a tipping-over: the arrangement knocked out of place rather than destroyed, and the upheaval still fresh.

chaotic.oewn-01673760-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely unmethodical → snarled into total wreckage

chaotic.oewn-01673760-s.tone: Sharpens the charge into a spectacle - not a trace of order or organization to be seen, where *disorganized* merely notes the lack.

helter-skelter.oewn-01673760-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely unmethodical → snarled into total wreckage

helter-skelter.oewn-01673760-s.tone: Its jingling shape makes the same invisible order sound hectic and headlong, far lighter in judgement than *chaotic*.

fucked-up.oewn-01673870-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely unmethodical → snarled into total wreckage

fucked-up.oewn-01673870-s.tone: Coarse and total - a snarl or dead stop treated as a botch someone is answerable for, the harshest word in the family.

snafu.oewn-01673870-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely unmethodical → snarled into total wreckage

snafu.oewn-01673870-s.tone: Names the same total snarl-up or standstill with a clipped, almost breezy label - rueful where *fucked-up* is furious.

scrambled.oewn-01674027-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely unmethodical → snarled into total wreckage

scrambled.oewn-01674027-s.tone: Faults the making rather than the thing: pieces flung together in haste, so the disorder sits in how it was put together.

unmethodical.oewn-01674152-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely unmethodical → snarled into total wreckage

unmethodical.oewn-01674152-s.tone: The coolest reproach here - it faults the missing method and the inefficiency that comes with it, and pictures no wreckage at all.

unstuck.oewn-01674290-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely unmethodical → snarled into total wreckage

unstuck.oewn-01674290-s.tone: Pictures the collapse as a coming-apart - what was holding gives way, and the disorganization or incoherence follows from that.

undone.oewn-01674290-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely unmethodical → snarled into total wreckage

undone.oewn-01674290-s.tone: Sounds the same collapse as an unmaking, graver and more final than *unstuck* - the thing not merely loosened but ruined.

patriotic.oewn-01744456-a.label: positive

family.axis: warm love of country → that love turned fanatical

patriotic.oewn-01744456-a.tone: The plain approving word for love of country, holding the feeling at a warmth that *jingoistic* has already burned past.

loyal.oewn-01744456-a.label: positive

family.axis: warm love of country → that love turned fanatical

loyal.oewn-01744456-a.tone: Casts the same love as steadfast attachment rather than ardour, quieter and less demonstrative than *patriotic*.

chauvinistic.oewn-01744607-s.label: negative

family.axis: warm love of country → that love turned fanatical

chauvinistic.oewn-01744607-s.tone: Condemning: the country's superiority held as an article of faith, all conviction and no judgement.

flag-waving.oewn-01744607-s.label: negative

family.axis: warm love of country → that love turned fanatical

flag-waving.oewn-01744607-s.tone: Mocks the display rather than the belief, reducing the fanaticism to noisy show where *chauvinistic* attacks the conviction behind it.

jingoistic.oewn-01744607-s.label: negative

family.axis: warm love of country → that love turned fanatical

jingoistic.oewn-01744607-s.tone: The sharpest edge in the group, hearing the fanaticism as belligerence rather than mere excess of zeal.

nationalistic.oewn-01744607-s.label: negative

family.axis: warm love of country → that love turned fanatical

nationalistic.oewn-01744607-s.tone: The coolest-sounding of the fanatical set, naming the excess as a doctrine where *flag-waving* names its noise.

ultranationalistic.oewn-01744607-s.label: negative

family.axis: warm love of country → that love turned fanatical

ultranationalistic.oewn-01744607-s.tone: Pushed past *nationalistic* to an extremity that leaves no reading in which the word admires what it describes.

superpatriotic.oewn-01744607-s.label: negative

family.axis: warm love of country → that love turned fanatical

superpatriotic.oewn-01744607-s.tone: Sarcastic: patriotism inflated past the point of belief, so the swelling itself is the accusation.

old.oewn-01648062-a.label: neutral

family.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

old.oewn-01648062-a.tone: Flat and unloaded, and it holds both readings at once — a long life lived or simply a stated age attained — where *of age* carries only the second.

aged.oewn-01648667-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

aged.oewn-01648667-s.tone: Formal and weighty where *older* is merely comparative, presenting advanced years as a settled condition rather than a point on a scale.

elderly.oewn-01648667-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

elderly.oewn-01648667-s.tone: The courteous way to say advanced in years, gentler in force than *aged* and careful to claim nothing further about the person.

older.oewn-01648667-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

older.oewn-01648667-s.tone: A comparative doing the work of a plain description, which is what makes it the softest term here — it implies a scale instead of naming a state.

senior.oewn-01648667-s.label: positive

family.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

senior.oewn-01648667-s.tone: Carries a note of standing rather than decline, making it the one flattering way in this set to say advanced in years.

of_age.oewn-01648983-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

of_age.oewn-01648983-s.tone: Purely a threshold reached, with none of the weight of accumulated years that *aged* brings with it.

aging.oewn-01649151-s.label: negative

family.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

aging.oewn-01649151-s.tone: Puts age in motion rather than in place - the process, not the state - and that forward motion carries its faint edge of decline.

ageing.oewn-01649151-s.label: negative

family.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

ageing.oewn-01649151-s.tone: The British spelling of the same word, carrying the identical sense of decline already under way.

senescent.oewn-01649151-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

senescent.oewn-01649151-s.tone: Clinical and detached: it states the same growing old as *aging* in a register that declines to feel anything about it.

ancient.oewn-01649289-s.label: negative

family.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

ancient.oewn-01649289-s.tone: Pure intensification — *old* taken to its limit, and the size of the exaggeration is what gives it its edge.

anile.oewn-01649409-s.label: negative

family.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

anile.oewn-01649409-s.tone: Formal in shape but withering in effect, covering both actually being a feeble old woman and merely resembling one, with the contempt built into the word rather than the sentence.

centenarian.oewn-01649490-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

centenarian.oewn-01649490-s.tone: Purely quantitative — it fixes a number where *ancient* only gestures at extremity, and passes no verdict with it.

darkened.oewn-01649594-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

darkened.oewn-01649594-s.tone: The one member describing what time does to the colour of a material rather than to a life, and it carries no judgement at all.

doddering.oewn-01649738-s.label: negative

family.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

doddering.oewn-01649738-s.tone: Contemptuous where *aged* is not, making the infirmity — of mind or of body — the whole of what it says about the person.

doddery.oewn-01649738-s.label: negative

family.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

doddery.oewn-01649738-s.tone: The same verdict of age-borne infirmity as *doddering*, its shorter form making the mockery sound offhand rather than deliberate.

gaga.oewn-01649738-s.label: negative

family.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

gaga.oewn-01649738-s.tone: Informal and blunt — the same infirmity as *doddering*, named in a word too flippant to leave the person any dignity.

thrifty.oewn-02429932-a.label: positive

family.axis: grudging withholding → resource-care counted as a virtue

thrifty.oewn-02429932-a.tone: Approving outright - care with resources treated as a settled virtue, where *penny-wise* grants that same care in miniature.

economical.oewn-02430138-s.label: positive

family.axis: grudging withholding → resource-care counted as a virtue

economical.oewn-02430138-s.tone: The cool one of the waste-avoiders — credits efficiency without implying any self-denial, which is what *frugal* adds.

frugal.oewn-02430138-s.label: positive

family.axis: grudging withholding → resource-care counted as a virtue

frugal.oewn-02430138-s.tone: The same waste-avoidance as *economical*, but worn as a discipline rather than run as an efficiency.

scotch.oewn-02430138-s.label: negative

family.axis: grudging withholding → resource-care counted as a virtue

scotch.oewn-02430138-s.tone: Barbed — the identical waste-avoidance of *economical* recast as an accusation of tightness.

sparing.oewn-02430138-s.label: neutral

family.axis: grudging withholding → resource-care counted as a virtue

sparing.oewn-02430138-s.tone: Neutral — names the holding back itself and leaves it unjudged, where *thrifty* has already decided the holding back is good.

stinting.oewn-02430138-s.label: negative

family.axis: grudging withholding → resource-care counted as a virtue

stinting.oewn-02430138-s.tone: Tips into fault — the restraint reads as giving less than is due, where *sparing* keeps the same restraint blameless.

penny-wise.oewn-02430607-s.label: negative

family.axis: grudging withholding → resource-care counted as a virtue

penny-wise.oewn-02430607-s.tone: Faint mockery — grants real thrift but confines it to small sums, so the praise arrives already qualified.

saving.oewn-02430693-s.label: positive

family.axis: grudging withholding → resource-care counted as a virtue

saving.oewn-02430693-s.tone: The flat attributive — ascribes thriftiness as a standing trait without pressing the approval *thrifty* carries.

noble.oewn-01592579-a.label: positive

family.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

noble.oewn-01592579-a.tone: The family's base term for the thing itself: it takes in character that is high, character that shows it, and anything that merely points to it.

dignifying.oewn-01592833-s.label: positive

family.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

dignifying.oewn-01592833-s.tone: Names what confers standing rather than what holds it - the honour is being handed over, where *noble* already has it.

ennobling.oewn-01592833-s.label: positive

family.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

ennobling.oewn-01592833-s.tone: More lift than *dignifying*: it raises what it touches rather than only decorating it with honour.

exalted.oewn-01593026-s.label: positive

family.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

exalted.oewn-01593026-s.tone: Reverent praise - it speaks of the height as though awe were owed to it, where *elevated* just records the same height.

elevated.oewn-01593026-s.label: positive

family.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

elevated.oewn-01593026-s.tone: The measured word for that height, stating the value with no lift in the voice at all.

sublime.oewn-01593026-s.label: positive

family.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

sublime.oewn-01593026-s.tone: The furthest reach here - elevation that overwhelms rather than merely impresses, beside which *grand* is only large.

grand.oewn-01593026-s.label: positive

family.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

grand.oewn-01593026-s.tone: Praises the sheer scale of the elevation where *exalted* praises its worth, so it impresses more than it moves.

high-flown.oewn-01593026-s.label: positive

family.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

high-flown.oewn-01593026-s.tone: The most emphatic in manner - elevation pitched loudly enough to be heard, where *elevated* keeps its voice level.

high-minded.oewn-01593026-s.label: positive

family.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

high-minded.oewn-01593026-s.tone: Sober, earnest approval: it admires the height without supplying any of the grandeur *grand* does.

lofty.oewn-01593026-s.label: positive

family.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

lofty.oewn-01593026-s.tone: Height with distance in it - approving, but it sets the thing above the ordinary rather than among it.

rarefied.oewn-01593026-s.label: positive

family.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

rarefied.oewn-01593026-s.tone: Praise with thin air in it: the elevation is so far up that it reads as select rather than shared.

rarified.oewn-01593026-s.label: positive

family.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

rarified.oewn-01593026-s.tone: The same select, thin-aired elevation as *rarefied*, spelled the other way.

idealistic.oewn-01593026-s.label: positive

family.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

idealistic.oewn-01593026-s.tone: The least awed of these - it credits the pitch of the standard rather than any grandeur in the thing.

noble-minded.oewn-01593026-s.label: positive

family.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

noble-minded.oewn-01593026-s.tone: Puts *noble* in plainer and more personal terms, naming high character straight out without the ceremony *exalted* carries.

greathearted.oewn-01593452-s.label: positive

family.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

greathearted.oewn-01593452-s.tone: The warm end of the family - nobility felt as open generosity, and plain-spoken where *magnanimous* is formal.

magnanimous.oewn-01593452-s.label: positive

family.axis: elevation conferred or plainly noted → elevation that awes and gives freely

magnanimous.oewn-01593452-s.tone: The formal, weighty word for that same generous nobility, stated as a virtue rather than felt as warmth.

alert.oewn-00092165-a.label: positive

family.axis: ordinary attentiveness → unbroken, sleepless watch

alert.oewn-00092165-a.tone: The baseline of the family - close observation stated flatly, with none of the danger *vigilant* keeps in view.

watchful.oewn-00092165-a.label: positive

family.axis: ordinary attentiveness → unbroken, sleepless watch

watchful.oewn-00092165-a.tone: Shares *alert*'s definition but leans on the habit end of it - observation kept up rather than switched on.

argus-eyed.oewn-00092618-s.label: positive

family.axis: ordinary attentiveness → unbroken, sleepless watch

argus-eyed.oewn-00092618-s.tone: The grandest word here, promising watch so total that no possible danger slips past, where *open-eyed* claims only that the eyes are open.

open-eyed.oewn-00092618-s.label: neutral

family.axis: ordinary attentiveness → unbroken, sleepless watch

open-eyed.oewn-00092618-s.tone: The flattest member - it names the posture of careful attention and looking out for danger without commending it the way *vigilant* does.

vigilant.oewn-00092618-s.label: positive

family.axis: ordinary attentiveness → unbroken, sleepless watch

vigilant.oewn-00092618-s.tone: Formal and dutiful: attentiveness owed rather than merely shown, with the possible danger always in the frame.

wakeful.oewn-00092618-s.label: positive

family.axis: ordinary attentiveness → unbroken, sleepless watch

wakeful.oewn-00092618-s.tone: The mildest of the danger-watching words - attention that is simply not asleep to what may be coming, well short of *argus-eyed*'s all-seeing claim.

fly.oewn-00092990-s.label: positive

family.axis: ordinary attentiveness → unbroken, sleepless watch

fly.oewn-00092990-s.tone: British informal, and it praises a different sharpness - not watching for danger but being too knowing to be taken in.

heads-up.oewn-00093129-s.label: positive

family.axis: ordinary attentiveness → unbroken, sleepless watch

heads-up.oewn-00093129-s.tone: Brisk and informal, it compresses full alertness into a word you could clap someone on the shoulder with, where *vigilant* keeps it solemn.

wide-awake.oewn-00093129-s.label: positive

family.axis: ordinary attentiveness → unbroken, sleepless watch

wide-awake.oewn-00093129-s.tone: Adds completeness to *alert* and little else - the force is all in the fully, with nothing left dozing.

lidless.oewn-00093245-s.label: neutral

family.axis: ordinary attentiveness → unbroken, sleepless watch

lidless.oewn-00093245-s.tone: Unsettling as much as admiring - watchfulness pictured as an eye that never closes, where *sleepless* says only that the watch never stops.

sleepless.oewn-00093245-s.label: positive

family.axis: ordinary attentiveness → unbroken, sleepless watch

sleepless.oewn-00093245-s.tone: Puts the cost in view: the watch is unbroken, at a price of rest that *watchful* never has to pay.
